name: WF-09 — Telegram Customer Support Bot
description: Claude-powered support via @ecAutopilot_bot → logs to Odoo CRM
trigger: Telegram message (any non-command message from customer)
steps: 2. Check if order status query → if yes, lookup WooCommerce by order# or email
3. If content query → send to Claude API with system prompt as Long Island Convenience support agent
6. Log conversation to Odoo helpdesk ticket (JSONRPC)
7. If Claude flags as unresolved → assign ticket to human in Odoo
claude_system_prompt: You are a friendly customer support agent for Long Island Convenience Store, serving customers in Long Island, Plainview, Hicksville, and surrounding areas in New York. Help customers with orders, products, delivery, and general questions. Be warm, local, and helpful. If you cannot resolve an issue, say you will escalate it to a team member.
